text: {"claims":[{"text":"I built an Android app in Kotlin that reached 50,000 downloads.","supported_by":[]},{"text":"In addition, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot for merchant settlement reports.","supported_by":["b3"]},{"text":"During my internship as a Backend Developer at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, wrote PostgreSQL queries and Flyway migrations, and improved the performance of our slowest settlement report from 9 seconds to 1.2 seconds using indexes.","supported_by":["b2","b3","b4"]},{"text":"Additionally, I handled payment events using Kafka consumers, wrote JUnit tests, and participated in the team's on-call rotation for two months, which strengthened my approach to system reliability and incident response.","supported_by":["b5","b6"]},{"text":"In my project work, I developed a library management system using Spring Boot, MySQL, and JWT authentication, and successfully deployed it on AWS EC2.","supported_by":["b7"]},{"text":"I also built a URL shortener in Go with Redis caching, which I load-tested to 2,000 requests per second.","supported_by":["b8"]},{"text":"My foundational skills include working with Git, Linux, and AWS services such as EC2 and S3.","supported_by":["b9"]}]}
